name: payment-flag
title: paymentFailure flag + red-herring frontend deploy
story: A feature flag makes Payment fail while a Frontend deploy lands minutes earlier as a red herring, and unrelated services flap. Compare the graph answer with the graph-removed answer.

name: silent-db
title: Silent PostgreSQL degradation (no change record)
story: astronomy-db slows down with nothing in the change log. With no change to correlate, the answer has to come from who calls whom and in which order things degraded.

name: noisy-neighbour
title: Saturated Kubernetes node (adHighCpu style)
story: One node runs Ad, Cart, Cache and Recommendation and hits ~97% CPU. Several services degrade at once; the common cause is the host, not any service.

name: catalog-lock
title: productCatalogLockContention style retry storm
story: A Product Catalog deploy hammers the database, so PostgreSQL also degrades and has no degraded dependencies of its own. The change record and onset order decide between them.

name: quote-no-breaker
title: Quote deploy where direct callers cannot circuit-break
story: Quote breaks after a deploy; its HTTP callers have no breakers, so the cheapest cut would shed the whole frontend. The agent says so and leads with the rollback.
